note: Everything a relying party needs to verify aae-envelope.jws offline. The DID document is testkeys/did-documents/agent-a.json from the aae-conformance-vectors repository, verbatim. It carries the public verification key only; no private key material is present in this fixture.

trust_decision.basis: The relying party accepts did:web:example.com:agent-a as an issuer of AAE grants for this exchange. draft-kroehl-agentic-trust-aae-00 Section 5 step 1 additionally requires the signing DID to equal the credential issuer, which the reference verifier enforces; the trust decision itself is the relying party's and is recorded here so the reproduction is complete.

keys_are_test_only: These keys are public and committed for reproducible vectors. Do not use them in production.
